findings.title: Ten price action setups, tested properly
findings.subtitle: Every rule turned into exact dials, found on 2022 to July 2024, judged on two sealed years
findings.conclusion: QQQ stands in for Nasdaq futures and SPY for S&P futures; regular hours only, real costs on every trade.

findings.title: Does price respect the lines?
findings.subtitle: Each claim measured on QQQ against a matched random baseline, checked on SPY and both eras

rows.title: Real levels vs random lines
rows.measure: hold rate at swing levels minus hold rate at random touched lines

rows.title: Hold rate by touch count
rows.measure: hold rate at levels with 3+ touches minus levels with 1 touch

rows.title: Many touches: wall or target
rows.measure: hold rate at 4+ touch levels minus 2-3 touch levels (positive = wall)

rows.title: Shrinking bounces
rows.measure: bounce (10 bars, ATR) at a later touch minus the earlier touch (claim: shrinks)

rows.title: A line against a box
rows.measure: hold rate measured at the box edge minus at the line

rows.title: Wick through vs close through
rows.measure: follow-through 1 ATR beyond after a close through minus after a wick through

rows.title: Flip zones
rows.measure: hold rate on the first retest of a broken swing minus random lines

rows.title: Break of structure, 10 bars
rows.measure: move in the break's direction after 10 bars (ATR)

rows.title: Break of structure, 20 bars
rows.measure: move in the break's direction after 20 bars (ATR)

rows.title: Break of structure, 50 bars
rows.measure: move in the break's direction after 50 bars (ATR)

rows.title: Change of character, 10 bars
rows.measure: move in the new direction after 10 bars (ATR)

rows.title: Change of character, 20 bars
rows.measure: move in the new direction after 20 bars (ATR)

rows.title: Change of character, 50 bars
rows.measure: move in the new direction after 50 bars (ATR)

rows.title: Sweeps vs closes through
rows.measure: reversal move (20 bars) after a sweep minus after a close through the swing

rows.title: Trends that start with a sweep
rows.measure: 20-bar move after a change of character with a sweep minus without

rows.title: Trend lines
rows.measure: hold rate at trend line touches minus random lines

rows.title: Fair value gaps hold
rows.measure: hold rate at a gap's first return minus random lines

rows.title: Fair value gaps fill
rows.measure: share of gaps filled within 50 bars minus random zones at the same distance

rows.title: Zones: first return vs later
rows.measure: hold rate on the first return to a zone minus later returns

rows.title: Pullback depth
rows.measure: 20-bar trend move after a deep (50%+) pullback minus a shallow one

rows.title: Engulfing and rejection at levels
rows.measure: 10-bar move after the candle at a level minus the same candle elsewhere

findings.conclusion: A claim survives only when its interval excludes zero on QQQ, SPY agrees and both eras agree.

findings.title: From every version to a short list
findings.subtitle: Versions left after each stage on QQQ discovery data, 2022 to July 2024
findings.conclusion: Each stage is fixed before the first run; candidates are saved and hashed before the sealed test.

findings.title: Each setup as a whole
findings.subtitle: Equal-weight average of all its versions, one 100-share position each, QQQ discovery
findings.conclusion: A setup works when its average made money per year, had a Sharpe of 0.5 or more, and made money in 2022 and in 2023-24.

findings.title: One rule changed, everything else equal
findings.subtitle: Average change in discovery Sharpe across matched pairs of usual-settings versions
findings.conclusion: Positive bars help on average; the share is how often the change helped in a matched pair.

findings.title: Win rate against profit
findings.subtitle: A sample of graded versions: a high win rate is not the same as making money
findings.conclusion: Versions with high win rates often lose: small targets and wide stops win often and lose big.

findings.title: Six systems, built as they are taught
findings.subtitle: Discovery results on QQQ, with the SPY Sharpe as the check
findings.conclusion: Lab defaults fill in anything the usual description leaves out.

findings.title: Still sealed
findings.subtitle: The last two years have not been read by any rule
findings.conclusion: It opens once, after the candidates and working setups are saved and hashed.
